title: Eagles in Middle-earth
blurb: Windlord, chief of the Great Eagles of Middle-earth, who rescues Gandalf and other heroes at pivotal moments across Tolkien's legendarium.
facts: Tolkien's Middle-earth, the Eagles or Great Eagles are immense birds that are sapient and can speak.
The Great Eagles resemble actual eagles, but are much larger.
Thorondor is said to have been the greatest of all birds, with a wingspan of 30 fathoms.
